question: I lost my company laptop on a trip. Who do I tell, and how quickly?
note: Deliberate citation typo: sentence 2 cites 'security/device.md' instead of 'security/devices.md', so its only citation is rejected and it is unsupported.

sentences.text: Report a lost or stolen laptop to the security team within 1 hour.
You can report it through the security help channel or the IT hotline.
